messages:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — DeltaHealth renewal: 9mo term, +12 seats prorated. They want EU entity on SOW and to wire. Draft here: https://drive.redwood/DeltaHealth/so_revA.pdf :paperclip:

sam_ae: I'll ping procurement now to get amended PO + billing entity + KYC. Requesting they cc finance. ETA 60-90m.

alex_fin: Treasury note — need PO + matching invoice by EOD 2026-04-10 to hit 4/12 cycle, otherwise next is 4/15. Provide invoice stub: RWI-2026-0427-DELTA / EUR 78,450.00 / PO: [placeholder].

julie_legal: Legal flag — if EU signer isn't on file we need a delegate authorization + entity KYC before DocuSign. I can prep the template.

ethan_se: I can handle DocuSign routing and will set signing order once billing name confirmed. Maya, confirm signer order?

maya_cs: Customer wants: 1) EU CFO, 2) Local Ops witness, 3) Redwood exec. Also they may request VAT split — Sam pls confirm.

sam_ae: Confirmed — procurement responded: they'll send amended PO + KYC and said single invoice preferred but asking about VAT split. Sending email now, cc finance.

docsign-bot: Reminder: Attach delegate_authorization.pdf if using delegate signer. DocuSign will follow signing order set by ethan_se.

maya_cs: Plan: (1) wait for PO+KYC, (2) legal adds delegate if needed, (3) ethan sends envelope, (4) finance targets 4/12 wire if docs in time. I'll update here on arrival.
